purpose: One explicitly authorized authoritative project build for the reviewed damping candidate; no source changes, program invocation, installation, solver or following action.
authorization: Root reads the complete two author files and the frozen production delta, obtains peer review, then separately authorizes one configuration per call. This author action does not invoke the script.

cpu.meaning: The standard CPU Debug task is satisfied only by a passed DebugCPU call. Fresh isolated Build is not called a Rebuild.
cpu.closure: Parse active ClCompile items from the authoritative project and require exactly the same 86 source paths as the actual retained same-configuration successful public build; require 86 fresh distinct object basenames including main.obj, hence 85 non-main.
cpu.libraries: Capture current hashes at the 17 resolved library paths from the successful same-configuration flux_operator helper recipe. Its immutable receipt supplies library path facts only; its historical source originals, objects, program and inputs are not revalidated as current. The new MSBuild and fresh CL/link command tlogs are recorded; the helper is never invoked.
cpu.postbuild: Refuse pre/post presence of src/VS/cg_variables.h or src/cg_variables.h because the existing CPU project has a conditional move event; do not modify that project event or claim the project has no side effects.

gpu.retained_recipe: Actual passed upl_column_public_Debug_r1.build.json or Release equivalent and its actual project_call and environment receipts, not a guessed command vector.
gpu.only_argument_changes: OutDir, IntDir and binlog are remapped, exactly three remaps; configuration and every other actual argument remain unchanged.
gpu.environment: Use the actual reviewed VsDevCmd.bat via cmd /d /c call -arch=x64 -host_arch=x64 then set; capture an immediate typed environment exit, apply process environment and publish only INCLUDE/LIB/VCToolsInstallDir/WindowsSdkDir/WindowsSDKVersion, never the full environment stdout.
gpu.closure: 111 fresh objects INCLUDING project main.obj, equal to the actual retained 110 non-main basename set plus main; 12 .cu.obj and 2 .h.obj are required. No retained object is linked or reused. GPU IntDir is fresh under the local temporary directory and must contain no whitespace.
gpu.tools_libraries: Current hashes at the actual four tool and six library paths from the successful GPU recipe are bound before/after; old mutable source originals are not traversed.

current_capture.source: At each authorized build invocation enumerate current src/source .cpp/.h/.cu/.cuh, require 265, capture hashes and copy bytes into a fresh per-config source snapshot. Accept the newly reviewed source contents, without comparison to old pre-damping source hashes. Recheck all originals, copies and path membership after the build.
current_capture.documentation: Capture and snapshot current doc/xml_format/_FmtXML_ElastoplasticSoil.xml and case02/README.md; verify both original/snapshot pairs before and after.
current_capture.protected: Capture seven distinct canonical bin/windows executable paths from the successful recipe, plus DsphConfig.xml, ChronoEngine.dll, dsphchrono.dll and vcomp140.dll currently in bin/windows. Require original hashes unchanged. Copy the four runtime files only into the fresh isolated executable directory; accept an already project-generated destination only if byte-identical, never overwrite a different file.
current_capture.identity: Historical recipe receipts and referenced actual call/environment records are immutable path/command evidence. Their source originals are not asserted current. Current source, doc, README, tools, libraries, project files, author files, protected canonical programs and runtime are late-captured before the build.

ownership: Precreate log; reset LASTEXITCODE to null immediately before the direct MSBuild invocation; copy it immediately after return; seal a fresh call JSON with its actual typed int exit and times BEFORE output hashing or postchecks. Environment setup is not a program/helper/solver test. Retain failed call/build records and all partial outputs; no automatic retry.

outputs.fresh_folders: outputs/tag (GPU executable in tag/gpu), outputs/tag_source; CPU src/VS/Intermediate/tag or GPU local Temp/upl_damp_r1/CONFIG/int. All must be absent, as must all new log/receipt destinations.
outputs.receipt_contract: stage/passed/configuration/platform/backend/build_target; direct typed owned exit fields and owned_exit_record:E/project_call:E (two aliases of the same sealed actual call); program:E; inputs:E[]; source_snapshot[265]={original:E,snapshot:E}; documentation_snapshot and case_readme_snapshot pairs; objects includes main (86 CPU or 111 GPU), non_main_object_count 85 or110, project_main_object:E, exact_object_basename_closure; canonical_programs_before:E[7]/unchanged; runtime_before:E[4], runtime[4]={original:E,copy:E}/unchanged; source_bindings_unchanged; log/binlog:E and compiler_linker_command_tlogs pairs. Failed builds may have missing/partial output entries and passed=false. No old GPU objects-exclude-main schema is silently claimed.
outputs.no_followon: No executable, help, solver, helper, component, reader, installation, process query, server, second configuration or next action is launched. No source or project edits; no arrays or CTE changes. No physical acceptance is established by compilation.

verification_this_author_turn: Source and actual retained schema read; static PowerShell AST and JSON checks only. No build or owner execution. Exact author hashes are handed off separately after final static review.
